name: spend-cap-button
title: Spend Cap Button
description: Buy button that remembers recent purchases of the same item ("You bought this 3 min ago") and needs a deliberate second click to buy again, previews the purchase against each cap, and refuses in the UI any spend that would break a cap, with the overage and reset time.

meta.stops: Same item bought twice by mistake
meta.summary: Asks for a second click before buying the same item again and shows each purchase against daily or monthly caps before it goes through.
meta.server: Enforce spending caps and dedupe purchases (idempotency key, recent-purchase check) on the server.
catches: A repeat purchase of the same item within duplicateWindow, including a double-click
Purchases that would break a daily or monthly cap, with the overage and reset time
This purchase as a slice of each cap
Held Enter (auto-repeat) firing a second purchase
limits: Caps and recent purchases come from props; another tab or device isn't seen until you update them
The block is UI-only; the purchase API must enforce caps
a11y: aria-disabled when a cap would break, aria-busy while pending, described by a polite hint
Escape disarms the second-click state; held Enter is ignored
Each cap is a role=meter with value text; animations respect reduced motion
